SELECT o.id,
    o.operation_id,
    o.credito_id,
    o.cliente_id,
    o.plataforma,
    o.external_credit_id,
    o.origen_codigo,
    COALESCE(origen.nombre, o.origen_codigo) AS tienda,
    COALESCE(c.nombre_completo, o.cliente_nombre_snapshot, 'Cliente sin vincular'::text) AS cliente_nombre,
    COALESCE(c.cedula, o.cliente_documento_snapshot) AS cliente_documento,
    o.original_amount,
    o.outstanding_amount,
    o.ally_paid_at,
    o.first_due_date,
    o.next_due_date,
    o.status,
    o.pre_nova,
        CASE
            WHEN o.pre_nova THEN 'pre_nova'::text
            WHEN na.decision = 'approved'::text THEN 'approved'::text
            ELSE COALESCE(na.decision, 'missing'::text)
        END AS nova_status,
    na.external_decision_id AS nova_decision_id,
    na.rule_version AS nova_rule_version,
    COALESCE(( SELECT sum(r.amount) AS sum
           FROM public.credit_repayments r
          WHERE r.obligation_id = o.id AND r.status = 'validated'::text), 0::numeric) AS validated_repayments,
    ( SELECT max(e.created_at) AS max
           FROM public.credit_collection_events e
          WHERE e.obligation_id = o.id) AS last_collection_at,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.credit_collection_events e
          WHERE e.obligation_id = o.id AND e.event_type = 'promise_broken'::text) AS broken_promises,
        CASE
            WHEN o.status = 'paid'::text THEN 'paid'::text
            WHEN o.status = ANY (ARRAY['loss'::text, 'refinanced'::text]) THEN o.status
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM public.credit_collection_events e
              WHERE e.obligation_id = o.id AND e.event_type = 'promise_broken'::text)) THEN 'promise_broken'::text
            WHEN o.status = ANY (ARRAY['late'::text, 'delinquent'::text]) THEN o.status
            ELSE 'current'::text
        END AS credit_outcome
   FROM public.credit_portfolio_obligations o
     LEFT JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id = o.cliente_id
     LEFT JOIN public.origenes origen ON origen.codigo = o.origen_codigo
     LEFT JOIN public.nova_authorizations na ON na.id = o.nova_authorization_id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cobra_quality_importer()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select public.cobra_quality_operator() and public.tiene_capacidad_aliados('revisor');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.creditos_cartera_puede_leer(p_origen_codigo text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.perfiles p
    where p.id = (select auth.uid()) and p.activo
      and (p.rol in ('gerencia','auditoria') or p.tienda_codigo = p_origen_codigo)
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rol_actual()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select rol from public.perfiles where id=auth.uid() and activo;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tiene_capacidad_aliados(p_capacidad text DEFAULT 'revisor'::text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select exists(select 1 from public.aliados_operadores o join public.perfiles p on p.id=o.perfil_id
    where o.perfil_id=auth.uid() and o.activo and p.activo
      and (o.capacidad=p_capacidad or o.capacidad='aprobador'));
$function$
